A '''cave spider''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] is very fast but very fragile, with as little as 1 heart of health.

== Spawning ==
Cave spiders appear from spawners as in vanilla, and from spawners in [[Abbey|abbeys]]. Abbey cave spiders drop nothing. Like other non-undead mobs, a cave spider that appears in the Overworld where it can see the sky is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/spawn_mechanic/check_mob_spawn.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Drops ==
{{Data/Loot/minecraft/entities/cave_spider}}
The drops are as in vanilla, except for cave spiders from the pack's spawners, which drop nothing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/cave_spider.json}}</ref> Mineshaft spawners are generated by vanilla code and don't tag their mobs, so mineshaft cave spiders drop normally.
